name: 05-to-asterix-cat062-rcs-writes-sp
source: EUROCONTROL-SPEC-0149-9 Edition 1.21, UAP (FRN 35 SP); IEEE 754 single for 0.25 is 3E800000; built by hand from the vector to-asterix-cat062-one-source-mon-1
reference: That vector's block with FRN 35 added: the third FSPEC octet gains FX (10 to 11), two more follow (01, then 02 for FRN 35), and the SP item 05 3E800000 ends the block; LEN 0x1F + 2 + 5 = 0x26. The runner's list rcs is not mapped; the top-level rcs_m2 is written.
